title: Ta’lim va o‘qish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ta’lim bosqichlari va o‘qish lug‘atidan foydalanasiz, o‘z mamlakatingiz ta’lim tizimini Britaniya yoki AQSh bilan solishtirasiz, qanday o‘rganishingizni tasvirlaysiz va nimani afzal ko‘rishingizni sabab bilan bir daqiqa davomida ayta olasiz.

vocab.uz: X ni Y dan afzal ko‘rmoq

scenes.title: Ta’lim va o‘qish haqida gaplashamiz
board: vocabulary · school systems · learning methods · preferences
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yangi darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda ishga kirish suhbatiga tayyorlandik va o‘zimizni yaxshi tomondan ko‘rsatishni mashq qildik. Bugun esa o‘qish va ta’lim haqida gaplashamiz: maktab va universitet lug‘atini o‘rganamiz, ta’lim tizimlarini solishtiramiz, o‘rganish usullarini tasvirlaymiz va nimani afzal ko‘rishingizni ravon aytishni mashq qilamiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Last time we prepared for job interviews. Today the topic is education. You'll learn the words for schools and universities, compare education systems, talk about how you like to learn, and say what you prefer and why.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! O‘tgan safar ish suhbatiga tayyorlandik. Bugungi mavzu ta’lim. Maktab va universitetlar uchun so‘zlarni o‘rganasiz, ta’lim tizimlarini solishtirasiz, qanday o‘rganishni yoqtirishingiz haqida gapirasiz va nimani afzal ko‘rishingiz hamda sababini aytasiz.

scenes.title: Ta’lim bosqichlari
board: AmE: elementary school · middle school · high school

examples.t: I started primary school when I was five.
examples.uz: Men beshyoshligimda boshlang‘ich maktabga bordim.

examples.t: She's in her final year of secondary school.
examples.uz: U o‘rta maktabning oxirgi yilida o‘qiyapti.

scenes.say_native: Avval ta’lim bosqichlarini ketma-ket aytib chiqamiz. Eng kichiklar uchun “nursery” — bog‘cha. Keyin “primary school” — boshlang‘ich maktab. Undan keyin “secondary school” — o‘rta maktab. Maktabdan keyin “college” yoki “university”. Amerikada boshqacha: “elementary school”, “middle school”, “high school”.
scenes.say: In Britain, children go to nursery, then primary school, then secondary school. After that, some students go to college and others go to university.
scenes.say_uz: Britaniyada bolalar avval bog‘chaga, keyin boshlang‘ich maktabga, keyin o‘rta maktabga boradi. Undan keyin ba’zilar kollejga, boshqalar universitetga boradi.

scenes.title: Odamlar va joylar

examples.t: The headteacher welcomed the new pupils.
examples.uz: Direktor yangi o‘quvchilarni kutib oldi.

examples.t: Our lecturer is also a researcher.
examples.uz: Bizning ma’ruzachimiz ayni paytda tadqiqotchi ham.

scenes.say_native: Endi odamlar. Britaniya ingliz tilida maktabda o‘qiydigan bola “pupil”, universitetda o‘qiydigan odam “student”. Amerikada esa ikkala holatda ham “student” deyiladi. Maktab o‘qituvchisi “teacher”, universitetda dars beradigan odam “lecturer”, individual yordam beradigan ustoz “tutor”.
scenes.say: At school you have a teacher, classmates and a timetable. At university you have lecturers, and sometimes a personal tutor who helps you with your studies.
scenes.say_uz: Maktabda o‘qituvchi, sinfdoshlar va dars jadvali bor. Universitetda ma’ruzachilar bor, ba’zan o‘qishda yordam beradigan shaxsiy tutor ham.

scenes.title: Diplomlar va imtihonlar
board: a bachelor's degree · a master's degree · a PhD
graduate from · do a degree in · get a diploma
sit / take an exam · pass ✓ · fail ✗ · revise

examples.t: She graduated from Leeds University in 2019.
examples.uz: U 2019-yilda Lids universitetini tamomlagan.

examples.t: I'm doing a degree in economics.
examples.uz: Men iqtisodiyot bo‘yicha daraja olish uchun o‘qiyapman.

scenes.say_native: Endi malakalar. Universitetdagi birinchi daraja “bachelor’s degree”, ya’ni bakalavr. Keyingisi “master’s degree” — magistr, undan keyin “PhD” — doktorlik. Universitetni bitirishni “graduate from” deymiz, ya’ni “from” kerak: “She graduated from Leeds University”. Imtihon topshirish — “take an exam”, Britaniyada ko‘pincha “sit an exam”.
scenes.say: To get a bachelor's degree, you usually study for three or four years. In Britain, students sit their exams in the summer.
scenes.say_uz: Bakalavr darajasini olish uchun odatda uch yoki to‘rt yil o‘qiladi. Britaniyada talabalar imtihonlarni yozda topshiradi.

scenes.title: O‘qish jarayonidagi iboralar
board: write an essay · hand in an assignment
meet a deadline · miss a deadline
take notes · do research · attend a lecture

examples.t: The deadline for the essay is next Friday.
examples.uz: Esse topshirish muddati kelasi juma.

examples.t: I always take notes during lectures.
examples.uz: Men ma’ruzalar paytida doim yozib boraman.

scenes.say_native: Endi o‘qish jarayonida eng ko‘p uchraydigan birikmalar. Esse yozish — “write an essay”. Topshiriqni topshirish — “hand in an assignment”. “Deadline” — oxirgi muddat; muddatga ulgurish “meet a deadline”, ulgurmaslik “miss a deadline”. Ma’ruzada yozib borish — “take notes”. Tadqiqot qilish — “do research”.
scenes.say: To succeed at university, you need to attend lectures, take good notes and do your own research. You also have to meet your deadlines.
scenes.say_uz: Universitetda muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun ma’ruzalarga qatnashish, yaxshi yozib borish va mustaqil tadqiqot qilish kerak. Muddatlarga ham ulgurish kerak.

scenes.title: Uch tipik xato
board: ✗ I made an exam. → ✓ I took / sat an exam.
✗ I graduated university. → ✓ I graduated from university.
✗ I learn at university. → ✓ I study at university.
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato o‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilarda tez-tez uchraydi. Birinchisi: “make an exam” deyish; bu “imtihon tuzish” degan ma’no bermaydi, to‘g‘risi “take an exam” yoki “sit an exam”. Ikkinchisi: “graduated university” — “from” tushib qolgan; to‘g‘risi “graduated from university”. Uchinchisi: “learn”
scenes.say: Careful! We don't make an exam, we take it or sit it. We graduate from a university. And we study at a university, but we learn new things.
scenes.say_uz: Ehtiyot bo‘ling! Imtihonni make qilmaymiz, uni take yoki sit qilamiz. Universitetni graduate from bilan tamomlaymiz. Universitetda study qilamiz, lekin yangi narsalarni learn qilamiz.

scenes.title: Bo‘sh joylarni to‘ldiring
board: 1) Tomorrow I have a test, so tonight I must ___.
3) The ___ for the essay is Friday. 4) In England, pupils ___ GCSE exams at sixteen.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gap. Tepada so‘zlar berilgan: revise, graduated, deadline va sit. Har bir gapni o‘qing va mos so‘zni tanlang. Uchinchi gapda muddat haqida gap ketyapti, to‘rtinchisida esa Britaniyada imtihon topshirishning o‘ziga xos fe’li kerak. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: tomorrow I have a test, so tonight I must what? Number two: she what from Oxford in twenty twenty?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: ertaga testim bor, shuning uchun bugun kechqurun nima qilishim kerak? Ikkinchi: u 2020-yilda Oksforddan nima qildi?

scenes.title: Javoblar

examples.t: I must revise tonight.
examples.uz: Bugun kechqurun takrorlashim kerak.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I must revise” — ertangi testga tayyorlanish. Ikkinchi: “She graduated from Oxford in 2020” — o‘tgan zamon, shuning uchun “graduated”. Uchinchi: “The deadline for the essay is Friday” — topshirish muddati. To‘rtinchi: “pupils sit GCSE exams” — Britaniyada imtihon topshirishning odatiy fe’li “sit”.
scenes.say: Number one: revise. Number two: graduated. Number three: deadline. Number four: sit. Well done!
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: revise. Ikkinchi: graduated. Uchinchi: deadline. To‘rtinchi: sit. Barakalla!

scenes.title: Britaniya va AQSh maktab tizimi

examples.t: In England, school is compulsory from the age of five.
examples.uz: Angliyada maktab besh yoshdan majburiy.

examples.t: American children finish high school at around eighteen.
examples.uz: Amerikalik bolalar o‘n sakkiz yoshlarda high schoolni tugatadi.

scenes.say_native: Endi ta’lim tizimlarini solishtirishga o‘tamiz. Angliyada maktab besh yoshdan o‘n olti yoshgacha majburiy, undan keyin o‘n sakkiz yoshgacha o‘qish yoki kasbiy tayyorgarlikni davom ettirish kerak. O‘n olti yoshda GCSE imtihonlari topshiriladi, keyin “A-levels” yoki kollej. Qo‘shma Shtatlarda bolalar birinchi sinfdan o‘n ikkinchi sinfgacha o‘qiydi va “high school”
scenes.say: In England, children must be in education until eighteen. At sixteen, they take their GCSE exams, and then many choose A-levels before university.
scenes.say_uz: Angliyada bolalar o‘n sakkiz yoshgacha ta’lim olishi shart. O‘n olti yoshda GCSE imtihonlarini topshiradi, keyin ko‘pchilik universitetdan oldin A-levels ni tanlaydi.

scenes.title: Davlat va xususiy maktablar
board: BrE: public school = expensive private school!

examples.t: My parents sent me to a state school.
examples.uz: Ota-onam meni davlat maktabiga yuborishgan.

examples.t: Fees at private schools can be very high.
examples.uz: Xususiy maktablarda to‘lov juda yuqori bo‘lishi mumkin.

scenes.say_native: Bu yerda mashhur tuzoq bor. Davlat maktabi tekin bo‘ladi, ingliz tilida “state school”. To‘lov evaziga o‘qiladigan maktab — “private school”. Lekin Britaniyada “public school” degani aslida eski, qimmat xususiy maktab! Amerikada esa “public school” oddiy davlat maktabi. Shuning uchun bu so‘zni ishlatganda kim bilan gaplashayotganingizga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Be careful with the word public. In Britain, a public school is actually an expensive private school, but in America it's a free state school.
scenes.say_uz: Public so‘ziga ehtiyot bo‘ling. Britaniyada public school aslida qimmat xususiy maktab, Amerikada esa tekin davlat maktabi.

scenes.title: Artikl: school, university, hospital
board: She went to the school. (binoga bordi)

examples.t: My sister is at university.
examples.uz: Singlim universitetda o‘qiydi.

examples.t: I went to the school to see the headteacher.
examples.uz: Men direktorni ko‘rish uchun maktabga bordim.

scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida artikl yo‘q, ingliz tilida esa bor, va bu mavzuda u ko‘p xato keltiradi. Qoida: agar siz maktabni o‘qish joyi sifatida, ya’ni asosiy vazifasi bo‘yicha nazarda tutsangiz, artikl qo‘yilmaydi: “go to school”, “be at university”, “after school”. Agar aynan bir binoni, joyni nazarda tutsangiz, “the”
scenes.say: A pupil goes to school, a student is at university, and a patient is in hospital. But if you visit the building for another reason, use the.
scenes.say_uz: O‘quvchi maktabga boradi, talaba universitetda o‘qiydi, bemor esa kasalxonada yotadi. Lekin binoga boshqa sabab bilan borsangiz, the ishlating.

scenes.title: Artikl xatolari
board: ✗ I go to the school every day. → ✓ I go to school.
✗ The education is important. → ✓ Education is important.
✗ After the school I play football. → ✓ After school…
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato. Birinchisi: o‘quvchi sifatida har kuni maktabga borishni aytayotganda “the school” deyish. To‘g‘risi “I go to school”. Ikkinchisi: umumiy gapda “the education is important” deyish; “the” ni olib tashlang: “Education is important”. Uchinchisi: “after the school” o‘rniga “after school”.
scenes.say: Remember: no article for general ideas and for the normal purpose of a place. I go to school. After school I play football.
scenes.say_uz: Eslang: umumiy tushunchalar va joyning odatiy vazifasi uchun artikl yo‘q. Men maktabga boraman. Maktabdan keyin futbol o‘ynayman.

scenes.title: Artikl kerakmi?
board: 2) I met her at ___ school gate.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda artikl kerakmi yoki yo‘qmi, o‘ylang. Birinchi gap: akam universitetda talaba. Ikkinchi gap: aynan maktab darvozasida uchrashdim. Uchinchi gap: ta’lim umuman haqida. To‘rtinchi gap: maktabdan soat to‘rtda chiqdik. Kerak bo‘lsa “the”, bo‘lmasa “no article” deb ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: my brother is at what university? Number two: I met her at what school gate? Number three: what education is a human right?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: akam qanday universitetda? Ikkinchi: u bilan qanday maktab darvozasida uchrashdim? Uchinchi: ta’lim inson huquqi.

scenes.title: Artikl javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “at university” — artikl yo‘q, chunki talaba sifatida o‘qiyapti. Ikkinchi: “at the school gate” — aniq bir maktab darvozasi, shuning uchun “the”. Uchinchi: “Education is a human right” — umumiy tushuncha, artiklsiz. To‘rtinchi: “We left school at four” — maktab o‘quvchilarning odatiy joyi, artikl yo‘q.
scenes.say: One: at university, no article. Two: at the school gate. Three: Education is a human right. Four: We left school at four.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: universitetda, artikl yo‘q. Ikki: maktab darvozasida. Uch: ta’lim inson huquqi. To‘rt: soat to‘rtda maktabdan chiqdik.

scenes.title: Solishtirish iboralari
board: both … and · similar to · the same as
different from · compared with · as … as

examples.t: Unlike in Britain, many US students live on campus.
examples.uz: Britaniyadan farqli ravishda, ko‘p amerikalik talabalar kampusda yashaydi.

examples.t: Both systems have exams at the end of the year.
examples.uz: Ikkala tizimda ham yil oxirida imtihonlar bor.

scenes.say_native: Ta’lim tizimlarini solishtirish uchun maxsus iboralar kerak. Farqni ko‘rsatish uchun “while” va “whereas” — “bir tomondan, boshqa tomondan”, shuningdek “unlike” — “…dan farqli ravishda”. O‘xshashlik uchun “both … and”, “similar to” va “the same as”. Farq haqida “different from” deymiz, Britaniyada “different to”
scenes.say: In England, school starts at five, whereas in some countries children start at six or seven. Unlike many students, I prefer exams to coursework.
scenes.say_uz: Angliyada maktab besh yoshda boshlanadi, ba’zi mamlakatlarda esa bolalar olti yoki yetti yoshda boshlaydi. Ko‘p talabalardan farqli o‘laroq, men kurs ishlariga qaraganda imtihonlarni afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Solishtirishdagi xatolar
board: ✗ same like → ✓ the same as / just like
scenes.say_native: Uchta xato o‘zbek tilidan keladi. Birinchisi: “different with”. O‘zbekcha “bilan” ta’sirida shunday deymiz, lekin to‘g‘risi “different from”. Ikkinchisi: “same like”. Yo “the same as” deymiz, yo “just like”. Uchinchisi: “more good”. “Good” ning qiyosiy darajasi “better”, ya’ni “Education here is better”.
scenes.say: Our system is different from theirs. My school was the same as yours. The teachers there are better than the teachers here.
scenes.say_uz: Bizning tizim ularnikidan farq qiladi. Mening maktabim sizniki bilan bir xil edi. U yerdagi o‘qituvchilar bu yerdagilardan yaxshiroq.

scenes.title: Solishtirib gapiring
board: while · Unlike · Both · the same as · from
1) Sam studies at night, ___ Mia studies in the morning.
3) ___ of us study English. 4) Her school was ___ mine. 5) Online is different ___ classroom learning.
scenes.say_native: Beshta gap, tepada esa beshta so‘z: while, unlike, both, the same as va from. Har bir gapga mos so‘zni toping. Birinchi gapda qarama-qarshilik bor. Ikkinchida akamdan farqli ekanim aytilyapti. Uchinchida ikkalamiz haqida gap ketyapti. Oxirgi ikkitasida o‘xshashlik va farq. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: Sam studies at night, what Mia studies in the morning? Number two: what my brother, I love maths. Number three: what of us study English.
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: Sem kechasi o‘qiydi, Miya esa ertalab o‘qiydi. Ikkinchi: akamdan farqli men matematikani yaxshi ko‘raman. Uchinchi: ikkalamiz ham ingliz tilini o‘rganamiz.

scenes.title: Solishtirish javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Sam studies at night, while Mia studies in the morning”. Ikkinchi: “Unlike my brother, I love maths”. Uchinchi: “Both of us study English”. To‘rtinchi: “Her school was the same as mine”. Beshinchi: “Online is different from classroom learning”. E’tibor bering, “while”
scenes.say: One: while. Two: Unlike. Three: Both. Four: the same as. Five: from.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: while. Ikki: unlike. Uch: both. To‘rt: the same as. Besh: from.

scenes.title: Tinglash: ikki talaba
board: What year are you in? · sophomore · uniform
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki talaba, britaniyalik Emma va amerikalik Jeyk, o‘z tizimlarini solishtirishyapti. Bu dialogda siz yaqinda o‘rgangan so‘zlarni va ikki xil ingliz tilidagi farqni eshitasiz. Savollarga javob berish uchun uch narsaga e’tibor bering: Jeyk nechanchi kursda, u maktabda forma kiyganmi va bakalavr daraja necha yil davom etadi.
scenes.say: Emma: What year are you in, Jake? Jake: I'm a sophomore, so second year. Emma: In Britain we say second-year student. Did you wear a uniform at high school? Jake: No, never. You? Emma: Yes, every day! Jake: And a degree takes four years here. Emma: Usually three in England.
scenes.say_uz: Emma: Jeyk, siz nechanchi kursdasiz? Jeyk: Men sophomoreman, ya’ni ikkinchi kurs. Emma: Britaniyada second-year student deymiz. Siz o‘rta maktabda forma kiyganmisiz? Jeyk: Yo‘q, hech qachon. Siz-chi? Emma: Ha, har kuni! Jeyk: Bu yerda bakalavr to‘rt yil davom etadi. Emma: Angliyada odatda uch yil.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 3) How long is a degree in England (usually)?
scenes.say_native: Dialogga qarab uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Jeyk nechanchi kursda va u o‘zini qanday atadi? Ikkinchi: Jeyk maktabda forma kiyganmi? Uchinchi: Angliyada bakalavr odatda necha yil davom etadi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap bilan ayting. Masalan, “He’s a sophomore” kabi to‘liq gap bilan javob bering.
scenes.say: What year is Jake in? Did Jake wear a uniform? How long is a degree in England, usually?
scenes.say_uz: Jeyk nechanchi kursda? Jeyk forma kiyganmi? Angliyada bakalavr odatda necha yil?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari

examples.t: He's a sophomore.
examples.uz: U sophomore, ya’ni ikkinchi kurs talabasi.

scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “He’s a sophomore”, ya’ni ikkinchi kurs talabasi. Ikkinchi: “No, he didn’t”, ya’ni Jeyk forma kiymagan; Emma esa har kuni kiygan. Uchinchi: Angliyada bakalavr odatda uch yil. Dialogdagi muhim til nuqtasi: Emma “second-year student” dedi, Jeyk esa “sophomore”. Bu amerikaliklar ishlatadigan so‘z: ikkinchi kurs “sophomore”, uchinchisi “junior”, to‘rtinchisi “senior”.
scenes.say: Jake is a sophomore, which means he's in his second year. He didn't wear a uniform. In England, a degree usually takes three years.
scenes.say_uz: Jeyk sophomore, ya’ni ikkinchi kursda. U forma kiymagan. Angliyada bakalavr odatda uch yil davom etadi.

scenes.title: O‘rganish usullari
board: learn by heart · take notes · make flashcards
study in a group · self-study · online course
read aloud · use a mind map · learn from mistakes

examples.t: I make flashcards to learn new words.
examples.uz: Yangi so‘zlarni o‘rganish uchun kartochkalar tayyorlayman.

examples.t: Some people learn better in a group.
examples.uz: Ba’zi odamlar guruhda yaxshiroq o‘rganadi.

scenes.say_native: Endi o‘rganish usullari. “Learn by heart” — yod olish. “Make flashcards” — so‘zlar yozilgan kartochkalar tayyorlash. “Mind map” — fikr xaritasi, ya’ni g‘oyalarni chizma ko‘rinishida yozish. “Study in a group” — guruhda o‘qish, “self-study” — mustaqil o‘qish, “online course” — onlayn kurs.
scenes.say: Some students learn vocabulary by heart. Others make flashcards or use a mind map. Studying in a group can be motivating, while self-study gives you more freedom.
scenes.say_uz: Ba’zi talabalar lug‘atni yodlaydi. Boshqalar kartochkalar tayyorlaydi yoki fikr xaritasidan foydalanadi. Guruhda o‘qish ruhlantirishi mumkin, mustaqil o‘qish esa ko‘proq erkinlik beradi.

scenes.title: Qanday o‘rganishni tasvirlash
board: I find it easier to + infinitive
The best way to learn … is to …

examples.t: I learn best by listening to podcasts.
examples.uz: Men eng yaxshi podkastlarni tinglash orqali o‘rganaman.

examples.t: I find it easier to study in the evening.
examples.uz: Kechqurun o‘qish menga osonroq.

scenes.say_native: O‘z o‘rganish uslubingizni tasvirlash uchun to‘rtta tayyor qolip bor. “I learn best by” dan keyin fe’lga “-ing” qo‘shiladi, chunki predlogdan keyin faqat shu shakl keladi: “by listening”. “It helps me to” va “I find it easier to” dan keyin esa “to” bilan infinitiv: “to write things down”.
scenes.say: I learn best by listening and repeating. It helps me to write new words down, and I find it easier to study early in the morning.
scenes.say_uz: Men eng yaxshi tinglab va takrorlab o‘rganaman. Yangi so‘zlarni yozib qo‘yish menga yordam beradi va erta ertalab o‘qish menga osonroq.

scenes.title: O‘qishdagi frazali fe’llar
board: look up · write down · fill in · hand in · work out
go over · catch up on · drop out of
pick up · find out · carry on · give up

examples.t: Look up the word in a dictionary.
examples.uz: So‘zni lug‘atdan qidiring.

examples.t: He dropped out of university after a year.
examples.uz: U bir yildan keyin universitetni tashlab ketdi.

scenes.say_native: O‘qishda frazali fe’llar juda ko‘p ishlatiladi. “Look up” — lug‘atdan qidirmoq. “Write down” — yozib qo‘ymoq. “Fill in” — shaklni to‘ldirmoq. “Hand in” — topshirmoq. “Work out” — masalani yechmoq. “Go over” — qaytadan ko‘rib chiqmoq. “Catch up on” — orqada qolganni quvib yetmoq. “Drop out of”
scenes.say: If you don't know a word, look it up. Write down new phrases, and go over your notes every week. Don't give up if you fall behind; you can always catch up.
scenes.say_uz: Agar so‘zni bilmasangiz, uni lug‘atdan qidiring. Yangi iboralarni yozib qo‘ying va har hafta yozuvlaringizni qaytadan ko‘rib chiqing. Orqada qolsangiz taslim bo‘lmang, doim yetib olishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Frazali fe’l va olmosh
board: ✗ Look up it. → ✓ Look it up.
✗ Hand in it. → ✓ Hand it in.
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato — olmoshni noto‘g‘ri joyga qo‘yish. “Look up”, “hand in”, “write down”, “work out” kabi ajraladigan frazali fe’llarda ot ikki joyda bo‘lishi mumkin: “look up the word” yoki “look the word up”. Lekin olmosh, ya’ni “it”, “them”, “him” har doim o‘rtada turadi: “look it up”, “hand it in”.
scenes.say: Don't say look up it. Say look it up. Don't say write down them. Say write them down. But go over them, because go over doesn't separate.
scenes.say_uz: Look up it demang. Look it up deng. Write down them demang. Write them down deng. Lekin go over them, chunki go over ajralmaydi.

scenes.title: Olmosh bilan almashtiring
board: 1) Write down the numbers. → Write ___ down.
2) Hand in your essay. → Hand ___ in.
4) Look up the new words. → Look ___ up.
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda otni olmosh bilan almashtiring. Birinchi: “the numbers” — ular, ya’ni “them”. Ikkinchi: “your essay” — u, ya’ni “it”. Uchinchi gap: “go over” ajralmaydigan fe’l, shuning uchun olmosh oxirida. To‘rtinchi: “the new words” ni olmosh bilan almashtiring. Hammasini butun gap qilib baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Write down the numbers. Hand in your essay. Go over the notes. Look up the new words. Now say each one with a pronoun.
scenes.say_uz: Raqamlarni yozib qo‘ying. Esseni topshiring. Yozuvlarni qayta ko‘rib chiqing. Yangi so‘zlarni qidiring. Endi har birini olmosh bilan ayting.

scenes.title: Olmosh javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “Write them down”. Ikkinchi: “Hand it in”. Uchinchi: “Go over them”, bu yerda olmosh oxirida, chunki “go over” ajralmaydi. To‘rtinchi: “Look them up”. Shuni yodda tuting: ajraladigan fe’lda olmosh o‘rtada, ajralmaydigan fe’lda olmosh oxirida turadi. Yangi frazali fe’lni o‘rganganingizda uni lug‘atdan tekshirib, ajraladimi-yo‘qmi, shunga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Write them down. Hand it in. Go over them. Look them up.
scenes.say_uz: Ularni yozib qo‘ying. Uni topshiring. Ularni qayta ko‘rib chiqing. Ularni qidiring.

scenes.title: O‘qish tarixingiz
board: I've been learning English for two years.
How long have you been studying?

examples.t: She has been studying medicine since September.
examples.uz: U sentabrdan beri tibbiyot bo‘yicha o‘qiyapti.

examples.t: I finished school in 2015.
examples.uz: Men maktabni 2015-yilda tugatganman.

scenes.say_native: O‘qish tarixingiz haqida gapirishda ikkita zamon kerak. Hozirgacha davom etayotgan jarayon uchun hozirgi tugallanmagan davomli zamon: “I’ve been learning English for two years” — ikki yildan beri o‘rganyapman, hali davom etyapti. Davomiylikni “for” bilan, boshlanish nuqtasini “since” bilan ko‘rsatamiz.
scenes.say: How long have you been studying English? I've been studying it for three years, since I started university. Before that, I studied French at school, but I stopped when I was sixteen.
scenes.say_uz: Ingliz tilini qancha vaqtdan beri o‘rganyapsiz? Men uni uch yildan beri, universitetga kirganimdan beri o‘rganyapman. Undan oldin maktabda fransuz tilini o‘rgandim, lekin o‘n olti yoshimda to‘xtadim.

scenes.title: For va since xatolari
board: ✗ I study English since two years.
✓ I've been studying English for two years.
✗ I've started in 2023. → ✓ I started in 2023.
scenes.say_native: Bu xatolar juda tez-tez uchraydi. Birinchisi: “I study English since two years”. O‘zbekchada “ikki yildan beri o‘rganaman” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa hozirgi oddiy zamon bilan “since” kelmaydi, hozirgi tugallanmagan davomli zamon kerak. Ikkinchisi: “for” va “since” aralashishi: davomiylik uchun “for two years”, boshlanish uchun “since 2023”.
scenes.say: Don't say I study since two years. Say I've been studying for two years, or since 2023. And with a finished time like in 2023, use the past simple: I started in 2023.
scenes.say_uz: I study since two years demang. I've been studying for two years yoki since 2023 deng. Va 2023-yilda kabi tugagan vaqt bilan oddiy o‘tgan zamonni ishlating: I started in 2023.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri zamonni tanlang
board: 4) How long ___ you ___ (work) on this project?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta gapda qavs ichidagi fe’lni to‘g‘ri zamonda ayting. Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda “for” va “since” bor, ya’ni davom etayotgan jarayon. Uchinchi gapda aniq o‘tgan vaqt: 2015-yil. To‘rtinchi gap savol, uning shakli biroz boshqacha. Har birini to‘liq gap qilib baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Number one: I what English for four years? Number two: she what here since September? Number three: I what school in 2015?
scenes.say_uz: Birinchi: men to‘rt yildan beri ingliz tilini nima qilyapman? Ikkinchi: u sentabrdan beri bu yerda nima qilyapti? Uchinchi: men maktabni 2015-yilda nima qildim?

scenes.title: Zamon javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I’ve been learning English for four years”. Ikkinchi: “She’s been studying here since September”. Uchinchi: “I finished school in 2015”, bu yerda oddiy o‘tgan zamon, chunki 2015 aniq vaqt. To‘rtinchi: “How long have you been working on this project?” — savolda “have”
scenes.say: One: I've been learning. Two: She's been studying. Three: I finished. Four: How long have you been working on this project?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: I've been learning. Ikki: She's been studying. Uch: I finished. To‘rt: Bu loyiha ustida qancha vaqtdan beri ishlayapsiz?

scenes.title: Afzal ko‘rishni ifodalash
board: prefer X to Y · prefer -ing to -ing
I'd rather + base verb (than + base verb)

examples.t: I prefer studying alone to studying in a group.
examples.uz: Men guruhda o‘qishdan ko‘ra yolg‘iz o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman.

examples.t: I'd rather study online than go to a classroom.
examples.uz: Sinfga borgandan ko‘ra onlayn o‘qigan yaxshi.

scenes.say_native: Endi nimani afzal ko‘rishingizni aytishni o‘rganamiz. “Prefer” bilan solishtirishda “to” ishlatiladi: “I prefer tea to coffee”, “I prefer studying alone to studying in a group”. “Than” bu yerda xato. Bitta tanlov haqida “I’d prefer to study online” deymiz. “Would rather” dan keyin “to”
scenes.say: I prefer reading books to watching videos. I'd prefer to study in the morning. I'd rather work in a small group than listen to a long lecture.
scenes.say_uz: Men videolar tomosha qilishdan ko‘ra kitob o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman. Ertalab o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman. Uzun ma’ruzani tinglagandan ko‘ra kichik guruhda ishlashni afzal ko‘raman.

scenes.title: Prefer va would rather xatolari
board: ✗ I prefer coffee than tea. → ✓ I prefer coffee to tea.
✗ I'd rather to stay. → ✓ I'd rather stay.
✗ I prefer study than work. → ✓ I prefer studying to working.
scenes.say_native: Uch xato. Birinchisi: “prefer coffee than tea”. O‘zbekchada “dan” qo‘shimchasi bor, shuning uchun “than” desak bo‘ladigandek tuyuladi, lekin “prefer” bilan “to” ishlatiladi. Ikkinchisi: “would rather to stay”. “Would rather” dan keyin “to” kerak emas, chunki u modal fe’lga o‘xshab ishlaydi: “I’d rather stay”.
scenes.say: Remember: prefer one thing to another, and would rather plus the base verb. I prefer coffee to tea. I'd rather stay at home.
scenes.say_uz: Eslang: prefer bilan to, would rather bilan to siz fe’l. Men choydan ko‘ra kofeni afzal ko‘raman. Men uyda qolganim yaxshi.

scenes.title: Gapni to‘g‘rilang
board: 3) I prefer read than watch videos.
scenes.say_native: Uchta gapda xato bor. Har birini toping va to‘g‘rilab ayting. Birinchi gapda noto‘g‘ri bog‘lovchi ishlatilgan. Ikkinchi gapda ortiqcha so‘z bor. Uchinchi gapda fe’l shakli xato, va yana bog‘lovchi ham. Oldingi sahnada ko‘rgan misollarni eslang. To‘g‘ri variantni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: I prefer tea than coffee. I'd rather to study alone. I prefer read than watch videos. Fix each sentence.
scenes.say_uz: Men choydan ko‘ra kofeni afzal ko‘raman, deb noto‘g‘ri aytilgan. Yolg‘iz o‘qiganim yaxshi, deb noto‘g‘ri aytilgan. Videodan ko‘ra o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman, deb noto‘g‘ri aytilgan. Har birini to‘g‘rilang.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantlar
board: 3) I prefer reading to watching films.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I prefer tea to coffee”, “than” o‘rniga “to”. Ikkinchi: “I’d rather study alone”, “to” ni olib tashlaymiz. Uchinchi: “I prefer reading to watching films”, ikkala fe’l “-ing” shaklida va ular orasida “to”. Yana bir to‘g‘ri variant: “I’d rather read than watch films”.
scenes.say: One: I prefer tea to coffee. Two: I'd rather study alone. Three: I prefer reading to watching videos. Or: I'd rather read than watch videos.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: choydan ko‘ra kofeni afzal ko‘raman. Ikki: yolg‘iz o‘qiganim yaxshi. Uch: videodan ko‘ra o‘qishni afzal ko‘raman. Yoki: videoga qaragandan ko‘ra o‘qiganim yaxshi.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: kuchsiz shakllar

examples.t: I'd rather stay than go.
examples.uz: Ketgandan ko‘ra qolganim yaxshi.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda kichik so‘zlar zaif aytiladi. “Than” to‘liq “dan” emas, balki qisqa “dhən” bo‘ladi, “to” esa “tə”. Shu sababli “I prefer tea to coffee” gapida “to” deyarli eshitilmaydi, urg‘u “tea” va “coffee” da. “I’d rather” — “aid-RAA-dhə”: “would” qisqarib “’d” bo‘ladi, urg‘u “rather”
scenes.say: I'd rather stay than go. Would you rather study alone? I prefer tea to coffee. Notice how the little words, than and to, are weak and quick, while the important words are strong.
scenes.say_uz: Ketgandan ko‘ra qolganim yaxshi. Yolg‘iz o‘qishni afzal ko‘rarmidingiz? Men choydan ko‘ra kofeni afzal ko‘raman. E’tibor bering, than va to kabi kichik so‘zlar zaif va tez aytiladi, muhim so‘zlar esa kuchli.

scenes.title: Tinglash: kursni tanlash
board: full-time or part-time? · online or classroom?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sara universitet maslahatchisiga kursni tanlash uchun keldi. Maslahatchi savol beradi, Sara esa nimani afzal ko‘rishini va sababini aytadi. Tinglang va e’tibor bering: Sara to‘liq vaqtli yoki yarim vaqtli o‘qiydimi, nega onlayn o‘qishni xohlaydi va maslahatchi nimani taklif qiladi.
scenes.say: Advisor: Would you prefer to study full-time or part-time? Sara: Part-time. I work in the mornings. Advisor: And online or in a classroom? Sara: To be honest, I'd rather study online, because I can go over the lessons again. But I miss talking to people. Advisor: Then a blended course might suit you: online lessons plus a weekly seminar.
scenes.say_uz: Maslahatchi: To‘liq vaqt yoki yarim vaqtda o‘qishni afzal ko‘rasizmi? Sara: Yarim vaqtda. Men ertalab ishlayman. Maslahatchi: Onlaynmi yoki sinfdami? Sara: Rostini aytsam, onlayn o‘qiganim yaxshi, chunki darslarni qayta ko‘rib chiqa olaman. Lekin odamlar bilan gaplashishni sog‘inaman. Maslahatchi: Unda aralash kurs sizga mos kelar: onlayn darslar va haftalik seminar.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Dialogni eslab, uchta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Sara qaysi shaklni tanlaydi va sababi nima? Ikkinchi: u nega onlayn kursni afzal ko‘radi? Uchinchi: maslahatchi nimani taklif qiladi? Javobingizni to‘liq gap qilib ayting, masalan “Sara prefers…” bilan boshlang.
scenes.say: Does Sara prefer full-time or part-time, and why? Why does she prefer online lessons? What does the advisor suggest?
scenes.say_uz: Sara to‘liq vaqtni yoki yarim vaqtni afzal ko‘radimi va nima uchun? U nega onlayn darslarni afzal ko‘radi? Maslahatchi nimani taklif qiladi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari: kurs tanlash
board: 1) Part-time, because she works in the mornings.
2) She can go over the lessons again.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Sara yarim vaqtli kursni tanlaydi, chunki ertalab ishlaydi. Ikkinchi: u onlayn kursni afzal ko‘radi, chunki darslarni qayta ko‘rib chiqa oladi. Bu yerda “go over” ishlatilganini eslang. Uchinchi: maslahatchi “blended course”, ya’ni aralash kursni taklif qiladi: onlayn darslar va haftada bitta seminar.
scenes.say: Sara prefers part-time because she works in the mornings. She likes online lessons because she can go over them again.
scenes.say_uz: Sara yarim vaqtni afzal ko‘radi, chunki ertalab ishlaydi. U onlayn darslarni yoqtiradi, chunki ularni qayta ko‘rib chiqa oladi.

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik nutq
board: 2) One difference from Britain or the USA
3) How you prefer to learn, and why
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy vazifa: bir daqiqa gapiring. Birinchi, o‘z mamlakatingizdagi ta’lim bosqichlarini va yoshlarini ayting. Ikkinchi, Britaniya yoki AQSh bilan bitta farqni solishtirib bering, “while”, “unlike” yoki “different from” ishlating. Uchinchi, qanday o‘rganishni afzal ko‘rishingizni va sababini ayting. To‘xtab qolsangiz, qolipni eslang: “I’d rather… because…”. Boshlang!
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Talk for one minute about education in your country. Compare it with Britain or the USA, and tell me how you prefer to learn and why.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Bir daqiqa o‘z mamlakatingizdagi ta’lim haqida gapiring. Uni Britaniya yoki AQSh bilan solishtiring va qanday o‘rganishni afzal ko‘rishingiz hamda sababini ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: In my country, children go to school at …
scenes.say_native: Namuna javobni tinglang va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. Muhim joylar: “go to school” artiklsiz, “whereas” bilan qarama-qarshilik, “I’d rather” bilan afzal ko‘rish va “because” bilan sabab. Bu namunadagi raqamlarni o‘zingizning haqiqiy ma’lumotlaringiz bilan almashtiring. Yaxshi nutq oddiy: bosqichlar, bitta aniq farq va shaxsiy fikr.
scenes.say: In my country, children go to school at about six. We study many subjects, whereas in some British schools pupils choose subjects earlier.
scenes.say_uz: Mening mamlakatimda bolalar taxminan olti yoshda maktabga boradi. Biz ko‘p fanlarni o‘qiymiz, ba’zi Britaniya maktablarida esa o‘quvchilar fanlarni oldinroq tanlaydi.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: school stages · degree · sit an exam · deadline
school systems · state / private · school (no article)
learn by heart · phrasal verbs · I've been … -ing for/since
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Ta’lim lug‘atini o‘rgandik: bosqichlar, degree, sit an exam, deadline va graduate from. Ikki tizimni solishtirdik, “public school” tuzog‘ini va “go to school” da artikl yo‘qligini ko‘rdik. “While”, “unlike”, “different from” iboralarini mashq qildik. O‘rganish usullari, frazali fe’llarning olmosh bilan joylashuvi va “for”
scenes.say: Great work! You can now talk about education, compare school systems, describe how you learn, and say what you prefer and why.
scenes.say_uz: Ajoyib ish! Endi ta’lim haqida gapira olasiz, maktab tizimlarini solishtira olasiz, qanday o‘rganishingizni tasvirlay olasiz va nimani afzal ko‘rishingiz hamda sababini ayta olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Compare education in your country and Britain / USA
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. O‘z mamlakatingiz va Britaniya yoki AQSh ta’limini solishtiruvchi taxminan yuz yigirma so‘zli matn yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida uchta solishtirish iborasi, masalan “while”, “unlike”, “different from”, kamida ikkita afzal ko‘rish tuzilmasi, masalan “prefer to” va “would rather”, hamda “go to school”
scenes.say: Your homework is to write about one hundred and twenty words comparing education in your country with Britain or the USA.
scenes.say_uz: Uyga vazifangiz: o‘z mamlakatingiz ta’limini Britaniya yoki AQSh bilan solishtiruvchi taxminan yuz yigirma so‘zli matn yozing.

homework_uz: O‘z mamlakatingiz va Britaniya yoki AQSh ta’limini solishtiruvchi taxminan 120 so‘zli matn yozing. Mezon: kamida 3 ta solishtirish iborasi (while, unlike, different from), kamida 2 ta afzal ko‘rish tuzilmasi (prefer … to …, would rather) va to‘g‘ri artikllar (go to school).

options: I did an exam yesterday to.
I passed an exam yesterday for.
quiz.why_uz: “Take an exam” (yoki sit an exam) deymiz; “make an exam” ingliz tilida bunday ma’no bermaydi.
Universitetni bitirish — “graduate from”. Davomi “from” bilan keladi.

quiz.q: In Britain, a 'public school' is usually…
quiz.why_uz: Britaniyada “public school” — eski, qimmat xususiy maktab. Amerikada esa davlat maktabi.

options: I go to the school every day.
I go to school every day.
I go to a school every day as a pupil.
quiz.why_uz: Maktab o‘quvchi uchun odatiy joy bo‘lsa, artikl yo‘q: “go to school”.

quiz.q: Which word has the stress on the syllable before the ending?
quiz.why_uz: “-tion” dan oldingi bo‘g‘inga urg‘u tushadi: qualifiCAtion.
“Different from” to‘g‘ri. O‘zbekcha “bilan” ta’siridagi “different with” xato.
Ajraladigan frazali fe’lda olmosh o‘rtada turadi: “look it up”.
Davom etayotgan jarayon va “for” bilan hozirgi tugallanmagan davomli zamon ishlatiladi.

options: I'd rather to stay at home.
quiz.why_uz: “Would rather” dan keyin “to” siz fe’l shakli keladi.
